introduction: Specification 09 defines the foundational repository cut: deleting dead provider wires, auxiliary subsystems, and obsolete tools; decoupling the agent runtime from sessions and middleware; directly detecting image magic bytes in read_file; renaming the module to github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go; enforcing an automated direct dependency allowlist; and eliminating wall-clock threshold tests.

glossary.dependency_allowlist: The policy-enforced list of approved direct module dependencies in the root go.mod.
glossary.driver_scaffolding: The agent runtime loop and tool dispatch engine that coordinates interactions between language models and workspace tools.
glossary.image_magic_bytes: The initial signature bytes of a binary file used to identify image formats such as PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP.
glossary.the_hands: The core workspace mechanics and code navigation tools of AgentKit, including file read/write/edit, symbol search, and command execution.

requirements.title: Provider and Auxiliary Subsystem Deletion
requirements.rationale: Removing unmaintained provider wires and auxiliary subsystems reduces maintenance overhead and removes unused dependencies.

criteria.action: remove provider backend packages for OpenAI, OpenAI Responses, Google, and Ollama (`provider/openai`, `provider/openairesponses`, `provider/google`, `provider/ollama`)

remove multi-wire provider support files (`provider/credentials.go`, `provider/credentials_test.go`, `provider/salvage.go`, `provider/salvage_test.go`, `provider/repair.go`, `provider/repair_test.go`, `provider/asymmetry_test.go`, `provider/conformance_test.go`, `provider/fuzz_test.go`)
retain `provider/anthropic` and `provider/faux` as the active provider packages
remove auxiliary packages `plugins`, `skills`, `_skills/code-review`, `cmd/validate-plugins`, `session`, `subagent`, `difftest`, `imagex`, `compaction`, `middleware`, and `stop`
remove deprecated example packages under `examples/` except `examples/agentdemo`, `examples/codingagent`, `examples/customtools`, `examples/codemode`, and `examples/mcp`

requirements.title: Root and Subsystem File Cleanup
requirements.rationale: Dead features, obsolete server abstractions, and obsolete test files must be pruned from the root and subsystem directories.

criteria.action: remove deleted tool and MCP server files `tools/fetch.go`, `tools/ssrf.go`, `tools/ssrf_test.go`, `tools/powershell.go`, `mcp/server.go`, `mcp/serve.go`, `mcp/server_test.go`, and `wire/bind.go`

remove obsolete root agent files `images.go`, `images_test.go`, `skillsconfig.go`, `skillsconfig_test.go`, `audit.go`, `audit_test.go`, `deferred.go`, `deferred_test.go`, `resume.go`, `resume_test.go`, and `resume_metadata_test.go`
remove deleted core definitions `core/audit.go`, `core/audit_test.go`, `core/trace.go`, and `core/plugin.go`
remove root tests for deleted subsystems including `plugin_wiring_test.go`, `middleware_wiring_test.go`, `events_test.go`, and `compaction_usage_test.go`

requirements.title: Inline Image Magic Byte Detection in read_file
requirements.rationale: Directly inspecting image header bytes avoids third-party image decoding dependencies while cleanly rejecting binary image formats.

criteria.action: prevent imports of `github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/imagex`, `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/imagex`, and `golang.org/x/image`

criteria.condition: read_file targets a file whose leading bytes match PNG magic bytes
criteria.action: return an error result identifying the PNG format
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK set to false, Error set to unsupported_file, and Detail stating that reading images is not supported and naming PNG

criteria.condition: read_file targets a file whose leading bytes match JPEG magic bytes
criteria.action: return an error result identifying the JPEG format
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK set to false, Error set to unsupported_file, and Detail stating that reading images is not supported and naming JPEG

criteria.condition: read_file targets a file whose leading bytes match GIF magic bytes
criteria.action: return an error result identifying the GIF format
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK set to false, Error set to unsupported_file, and Detail stating that reading images is not supported and naming GIF

criteria.condition: read_file targets a file whose leading bytes match WebP magic bytes
criteria.action: return an error result identifying the WebP format
criteria.contract: core.ToolResult with OK set to false, Error set to unsupported_file, and Detail stating that reading images is not supported and naming WebP

criteria.action: omit image block descriptions and output schema properties for image results in the read_file tool declaration

requirements.title: Toolset and Conformance Pruning
requirements.rationale: Removing unneeded tools reduces attack surface and aligns tool registration with the hands-only core.

criteria.action: omit registration of `fetch_url`, `powershell`, and `subagent`
for any tool returned by tools.All, ensure its name belongs to the approved set of workspace mechanics and code navigation tools
omit tests for `fetch_url`, `powershell`, and `subagent` from the tool conformance suite

requirements.title: Agent Scaffolding Decoupling
requirements.rationale: Agent execution must function without session persistence, compaction tokens, middleware wrappers, or audit and tracing hooks.

criteria.action: remove struct fields and methods referencing `session.Recorder` or `middleware.Chain` from `agent.go`
remove the call to `compaction.EstimateContextTokens` and the `Continue` method from `loop.go`
restrict provider registration in `providers.go` to `anthropic` and `faux` provider implementations
preserve ParentToolUseID event linkage, tool concurrency, and result aggregation while omitting audit logging calls and tracer spans

requirements.title: Module Rename and Canonical Import Paths
requirements.rationale: Aligning the module path with the GitHub repository coordinates ensures consistent Go toolchain dependency resolution.

criteria.action: declare module path `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go` in the root `go.mod`
for any Go source or test file across the repository, rewrite import paths from `github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go` to `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go`

declare module `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/codesearch` in `codesearch/go.mod`, require `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go v0.0.0`, and set `replace github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go => ..`

requirements.title: Dependency Allowlist Policy Gate
requirements.rationale: Restricting direct dependencies prevents dependency bloat and transitive security vulnerabilities.

criteria.action: prune direct dependencies `golang.org/x/net`, `golang.org/x/image`, `golang.org/x/time`, and `code.dny.dev/ssrf` from the root `go.mod`

criteria.condition: the dependency allowlist test in `internal/policy/deps_test.go` inspects direct dependencies from `go list -m`
criteria.action: assert that every direct dependency belongs to the approved direct dependency set

criteria.condition: an unapproved direct dependency is listed in the root module
criteria.action: fail the test and print the unexpected dependency name
criteria.contract: test failure via t.Fatalf or t.Errorf naming the disallowed module

requirements.title: Elimination of Flaky Timing Tests and Target Cleanup
requirements.rationale: Removing wall-clock thresholds and unneeded targets eliminates false CI failures under resource contention.

criteria.action: remove `perf_budget_test.go` from the repository
remove wall-clock duration threshold comparisons from test assertions in `tools/concurrency_test.go`
remove `difftest` and `examples/codesearch` targets and the `build-examples` target from `Makefile`
execute fmt, vet, lint, and test across the root module and codesearch without failures
criteria.contract: zero exit code from make check

execution_paths.title: Developer runs the repository build and dependency policy gate

steps.action: executes `make check` in the repository root
runs `gofmt`, `go vet`, and `go test` across the root module and the `codesearch` submodule
queries `go list -m` to inspect all direct dependencies against the approved allowlist
verifies all tests pass with zero duration threshold flakes and outputs success

execution_paths.title: Agent executes read_file on an image file and receives format-specific rejection

steps.action: initiates an agent tool execution calling `read_file` with the path to a PNG image file
reads leading magic bytes from the target file without invoking external image decoders
detects PNG header bytes and constructs a structured error result
receives the error result indicating unsupported file format naming PNG

execution_paths.title: Embedded consumer initializes Agent without legacy middleware or session recorder

steps.action: constructs an AgentConfig specifying Anthropic provider and registers default tools
creates an Agent instance decoupled from session recorder and middleware chains
executes a user prompt turn using Anthropic provider and emits execution events
receives the completed run result with valid token usage and conversation history
